scope: Post-repair source/meter interpretation and fixed-cohort readout sensitivities; no model, map or package change
primary_cohort: Same 8651 source-qualified and equation/loss-qualified hours in the physical-repair baseline and Moses-repair candidate
direction_basis: Official seasonal Central East/Total East definitions include Plattsburgh to Sand Bar under D-to-N; the archived PAR diagram defines the opposite Sand Bar to NY sign as positive
baseline_augmentation_warning: Baseline did not separately route PV20. Adding a reported PV20 component to its coarse readout is a hybrid sensitivity, not a corrected baseline physical prediction.
candidate_augmentation_warning: Candidate routes the PV20 proxy explicitly but its frozen CE/TE operators omit it. Adding its export component is source-directed partial scope accounting, not certification of remaining physical circuit terms or the P32 expression.
native_P34_semantics: Operator-reported native numeric flow values; adopted numeric-as-MW and forward-hold aggregation. Raw MWH header, publication origin and native timestamp support remain independently unresolved.
source_meter_qualification: Sand Bar PAR is not the Plattsburgh boundary meter. South Hero net load/injection, intervening loss and bypass terms are unresolved; no complete numerical error bound is established.
historical_sign_qualification: The 2026-01-09 and 2026-07-17 official diagrams corroborate the same Sand Bar sign; no retrieved source certifies its effective date throughout 2025.
CentralEast_channel_qualification: The CEVC24 physical interface definition includes PV20, but exact public P32 CENTRAL EAST - VC telemetry weights/expression are not independently certified.
promotion: None: retain all declared sensitivity rows and do not choose an operator, sign or source scale by its score.
